featured_reviews.name: Arun Gavhare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience learning at Yogesh Motor Driving School. Yogesh sir is an excellent instructor who teaches with great patience, calmness, and professionalism. As a beginner, I felt very comfortable and confident throughout the learning process because of the way he explains every step so clearly and practically.
His teaching style not only helped me learn driving properly but also built strong self-confidence while driving on the road. Every session was encouraging, well-guided, and focused on making me a safe and confident driver.
I would highly recommend Yogesh Motor Driving School to anyone who wants to learn driving in a professional and friendly environment.

featured_reviews.name: Rozy James
featured_reviews.review_text: ​"Excellent experience! Yogesh Sir is a fantastic instructor who ensures you're road-ready from day one. The training is professional, and the vehicles are clean and in great condition. Additionally, the help with documentation is a huge bonus—they guide you through every single step until you have your license in hand. Highly recommended for anyone in the area, especially for all the women who are looking forward to finding their 'ROAD WINGS.' It’s a safe, supportive, and empowering place to start learning!"

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Rhyno
featured_reviews.review_text: The best driving school in the Vasai-Naigaon region. Yogesh Bhau is the best teacher, using his personal, well-maintained car. He takes different routes every time, which helps with learning to drive in every type of traffic. Flexible with not only daily routine learning, but also on highways & Ghat roads, once you are confident, and want to extend your learning and driving skills. Yogesh Bhau is now my new friend. He made my learning experience pleasant and interesting. Thanks, Yogesh Bhau.

featured_reviews.name: plutorch gaming
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very good experience with Yogesh Motor Driving School. The trainers are calm, professional, and very supportive, especially for beginners. They explain traffic rules, parking, clutch control, and road confidence in a very simple way.

featured_reviews.name: vibhuti N. kour
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm extremely satisfied with the driving lessons. Yogesh sir is very patient and understands each student's strengths and weaknesses, adapting the teaching approach accordingly. The way road rules and regulations are explained is clear and concise. The teacher also takes care of students' mental well-being, making the learning process comfortable and effective. I'm grateful for the guidance and support provided. Everything about the driving school is excellent, from the teaching style to the overall experience. Thank you, Yogesh Sir, for being an exceptional instructor!"

featured_reviews.name: Ria Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text: I was happy to learn driving at yogesh driving school as the instructions are clear. The trainer (Mr. Yogesh) inherits a lot of patience and calmly provides hands on learning experience. One of the best motor driving training centre.
